method: Targeted official search, EUR-Lex procedure and document views, documented Cellar RDF tree and XML object notices, and direct examination of previously retrieved exact Commission PDFs. Repository creation/modification timestamps were not treated as publication dates.

observed_evidence.locator: EUR-Lex Consolidated texts, explanation of the header date
observed_evidence.finding: The header date denotes applicability of the latest included amendment, not the date the consolidation was published.

observed_evidence.locator: Cellar XML object notice, Accept: application/xml;notice=object; retrieved 2026-09-05T20:38:53.386Z, HTTP 200
observed_evidence.finding: ACT_CONSOLIDATED_DATE and WORK_DATE_DOCUMENT are 2026-07-27; DATE_CREATION_LEGACY is 2026-08-03; CREATIONDATE is 2026-08-03T11:21:17.028+02:00 and LASTMODIFICATIONDATE is 2026-08-11T22:42:17.608+02:00. None is a separately labelled official publication date.

hold_reasons: The exact official publication day remains unestablished. Repository ingestion/creation and consolidation applicability dates have different meanings and cannot be substituted.

observed_evidence.locator: Cellar XML object notice, Accept: application/xml;notice=object; retrieved 2026-09-05T20:38:53.587Z, HTTP 200
observed_evidence.finding: WORK_DATE_DOCUMENT is 2026-03-13; DATE_CREATION_LEGACY is 2026-04-10 and repository creation/modification is 2026-04-10T12:55:16.526+02:00. This independently supports the retained document date, but not its use as publication date.

observed_evidence.locator: Exact working-document footnote 1, compared with the parent opinion's OJ masthead
observed_evidence.finding: The working document is described as published on EUR-Lex alongside the opinion. The opinion's OJ date is 15 April 2026. 'Alongside' does not independently date the separate working-document manifestation.

hold_reasons: The exact attachment publication day remains unestablished. The March document date, April repository creation timestamp and parent opinion's OJ publication are not interchangeable.
access_limitations: The direct EUR-Lex text view presented a JavaScript verification challenge and the ALL view returned no readable metadata; no challenge was bypassed. The independently documented public Cellar API was used for its own metadata.

observed_evidence.locator: EUR-Lex procedure view for SEC(2021)167, headings for adoption/transmission and OJ publication
observed_evidence.finding: This is the whole AI Act procedure, not a dated publication record for the SEC package. The final Act's 12 July 2024 OJ date is unrelated to publication of this supporting opinion.

observed_evidence.locator: Commission Regulatory Scrutiny Board page, How it works
observed_evidence.finding: The general policy publishes impact assessments and opinions once the related proposal is adopted. It does not prove the exact day this particular SEC package was released.

hold_reasons: No exact dated official publication manifestation of the SEC package was recovered. The retained 23 April 2021 date is only evidenced as the Council cover-note date in the previous pass.
access_limitations: Both probed Cellar identifier notices returned HTTP 404; this is an identifier-access result, not evidence that the SEC document does not exist. EUR-Lex ALL returned cache miss and the data-portal dataset page exposed no readable content.

observed_evidence.locator: Official title; OJ C/2024/506 masthead; amendments 3 and 12
observed_evidence.finding: The Parliament adopted the amendments on 14 June 2023; the primary cited OJ manifestation was published on 23 January 2024. The amendments substantively regulate cross-sector AI.

records.authorization: The user explicitly approved the narrow compatibility correction for institutional adoption of adopted institutional positions. Independent date evidence and legal_status adopted remain required.

observed_evidence.locator: Commission library Publication 20 July 2026; exact PDF covers; approval communication's final paragraphs; annex paragraphs 3-5
observed_evidence.finding: The exact artifact is the content-approved draft annex to C(2026)5054, with a separately existing approval communication. Formal adoption is expressly deferred. Paragraph 4 identifies input on the consultation draft, supporting the recorded revision relationship.

records.authorization: The user explicitly approved version relationships across independently evidenced principal/attachment manifestations. A linked attachment must still have its own valid direct parent; the prior verified consultation draft is unchanged.

search_queries: site:commission.europa.eu regulatory scrutiny board opinions published once initiative adopted
